description: Prompt-robustness variant: radiology-report register. Same probe structure, classes, and pos/neg counts as configs/prompts/cxr_prompts.json; only the phrasing STYLE changes (Findings/Impression report sentences). Used with run_medtec.py --prompts-file to test whether L4/L5 collapse survives report-style phrasing.
